CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 24, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – March 10, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 10, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the March 10, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Consent Agenda Item 1 due to abstentions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-016
  • 701 West Hellman Avenue
  • Applicant: Krystina Tsengs
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of five (5)
  windows on an existing 1-story single-family residence.

  1
  03/24/2026
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application due to absence of project
  representative.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-176
  • 610 North Garfield Avenue
  • Applicant: Monica Vadillo
  • Request: This is an application for the replacement of various
  exterior doors and windows, as well as the addition of new windows,
  on an existing 2-story multi-family residential building.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-020
  • 1148 South Garfield Avenue
  • Applicant: John Estrada
  • Request: This is an a application for new wall signs on an existing 1-
  story commercial building for a new business known as “Alhambra
  Medical Center.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  2
  03/24/2026
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise Sign #2 to be centered between the existing breeze
  blocks. Provide notes and/or dimensions accordingly.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-23-098
  • 1208 South Electric Avenue
  • Applicant: Cristhian Aguilar
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  1-story single-family residence, including the removal of four (4)
  windows, installation of new wall cladding, replacement of window
  trim, and a redesign of the front porch roof and supports.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide two (2) perpendicular rafters at the front porch trellis
  to match the original architectural design of the house,
  including cloud-lifted rafter tail detailing at the exposed ends.
  2. Adjust the siding to stucco transition along the South
  Elevation to terminate at the west edge of window.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-131
  • 215 South Meridian Avenue & 285 Hampden Terrace
  • Applicant: Ben Lin

  3
  03/24/2026
   •  Request: This is an application for focused demolition of an existing
  arched wing wall and covered entry porch, as well as exterior
  alterations and re-design of an existing 1,554 SF 1-story single-family
  primary dwelling unit and an existing 932 SF 1-story single-family
  secondary unit, along with a new side yard fence on a single
  residential property.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the plans to show the location and design of all
  proposed roof gutters.
  2. Identify the location of the proposed water heater enclosure
  on the plans and elevation.
  3. Correct all plan references and labeling to accurately identify
  the second dwelling unit, to ensure it is not mistakenly
  designated as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU).

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-1-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  Ng
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  4
  03/24/2026
 F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:49 P.M. to
  Tuesday, April 14, 2026, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
